messages:
olivia: heads up — acme-inc reporting 401s from our SDK and CI jobs right after the nightly API key rotation (07:12 UTC).

sam: on it. can you paste a minimal repro/log?

olivia: customer reproducer: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/health -> 401

ci-runner: [bot] from CI logs: "auth failed: invalid_api_key (key_id: s-AB12CD)" at 07:14:03 UTC

mike: quick hypothesis — if the secret store label (AWSCURRENT) didn't get repointed during rotation, services fetching by secret name (no version-id) will keep getting old value.

amanda: rotation lambda should call UpdateSecretVersionStage. any errors in the rotation lambda logs?

sam: pulled rotation-lambda logs:
```
2026-03-17T07:12:18Z INFO PutSecretValue succeeded, versionId: 9f3b...
2026-03-17T07:12:19Z ERROR UpdateSecretVersionStage failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/rotation-lambda-role is not authorized to perform: secretsmanager:UpdateSecretVersionStage
```

security-bot: [policy-change] 2026-03-16T23:45 policy-engine applied update "restrict-kms-reencrypt" to role rotation-lambda-role (PR #2345)

mike: that lines up — PutSecretValue used KMS (succeeded) but UpdateSecretVersionStage needs secretsmanager:UpdateSecretVersionStage which requires appropriate KMS permissions for the rotation principal in cross-account/alias scenarios. The PR tightened kms actions and accidentally removed that permission.

olivia: ok immediate mitigation? customer needs access restored asap.

sam: manual mitigation steps (we executed):
1) identified new version id from rotation lambda log (9f3b...).
2) ran: `aws secretsmanager update-secret-version-stage --secret-id arn:aws:secretsmanager:eu-west-1:111111:secret:acme/api-key --version-stage AWSCURRENT --move-to-version-id 9f3b...`
3) restarted CI runners / flushed SDK caches (some services cache key for 5m).

mike: also rolled back the restrictive policy on rotation-lambda-role to restore UpdateSecretVersionStage. Created a temporary exception and opened a follow-up to tighten KMS actions more safely.

amanda: customer confirms green after manual update and CI restarts.

olivia: root cause summary for ticket: rotation succeeded (new secret version created) but secretsmanager stage update failed due to recently-applied IAM/KMS policy changes, leaving AWSCURRENT pointing at old version and causing token mismatch across services that fetch by secret name.

sam: follow-ups / action items:
- eng-infra: add post-rotation verification job that checks AWSCURRENT points to the latest version (sam)
- security: review PR #2345 and add a policy integration test for rotation-lambda-role (amanda)
- devex: update runbook to recommend fetching by version-id for short-lived CI jobs or reduce cache TTL (mike)
- ops: add alert if rotation writes new version but AWSCURRENT unchanged after 30s (mike)

mike: proposed temporary tweak for CI to reduce secret cache TTL: set REDWOOD_SECRET_CACHE_TTL=30s in runner image; will send PR.

olivia: assigning ticket SPT-4821 to eng-infra with priority P1. ETA for full fix 48h.

ci-runner: [bot] deployment completed for acme-inc at 08:05 UTC — all services reporting healthy.

omitting further debug logs for brevity — closing thread once runbook and PRs are in motion. :white_check_mark:
